items.why: Extending Friday's 6% rally on reports Meta will begin manufacturing its custom AI chip, codenamed Iris, in September. BofA reiterated its Buy rating and $835 price target.
Riding Friday's Q3 delivery beat: 486,532 vehicles topped the roughly 456,000 consensus, and the stock is holding those gains ahead of Oct 21 earnings.
Upgraded to Buy at Melius Research on Monday with the price target raised to 665, calling Microsoft the trusted leader in AI security for enterprises.
Testing all-time highs, per Yahoo Finance coverage, with chip names including Nvidia flagged as Monday's movers in Barron's market coverage.

market_note: S&P and Nasdaq futures higher, 10-year yield ticking up toward new highs.
summary: Big tech is leading Monday's tape, with Meta, Tesla and Microsoft all climbing while the Dow slips. Rising Treasury yields are pressuring blue chips as growth names take the lead.
